title: tex_mobject¶
content:
tex_mobject¶

Mobjects representing text rendered using LaTeX.

Important

See the corresponding tutorialText With LaTeX

Note

Just as you can useText(from the moduletext_mobject) to add text to your videos, you can useTexandMathTexto insert LaTeX.

Classes

BulletedList

A bulleted list.

MathTex

A string compiled with LaTeX in math mode.

SingleStringMathTex

Elementary building block for rendering text with LaTeX.

Tex

A string compiled with LaTeX in normal mode.

Title

A mobject representing an underlined title.
